correctness.rationale: The Hamiltonian potential is even, C1, strictly increasing on positive x, and proper, giving a single periodic orbit for every E>0. Inner and outer branch harmonic solutions yield times arctan(Ω/s)/Ω and arctan(ms/Ω²)/m; E−Ec=s²/2. Exact differentiation gives dT/ds=4s²/((s²+Ω²)(m²s²+Ω⁴)), positive for every s>0. Taylor expansions prove the one-half and three-halves laws and exact cubic ratio; large-s expansions give the far endpoint. Physical-time phase conjugacy and monotonic frequency classify all sampled rational/irrational energies and their two-thirds inverse localization. Independent ODE RK4 checks 16 cases and symbolic derivative check passed, but are not substitutes for the analytical proof.

The contribution is a structural boundary classification despite its elementary branch-matching proof.
